cuts.reason: Cuts from the wide two-shot of the kitchen into a tight close-up on the wife exactly as she starts her deflecting answer ('That we're still figuring it out'), isolating her for the lie.
Cuts from the wife's close-up to a matching close-up on the husband right after her punchline line 'She doesn't need to know that,' landing on his deadpan reaction for the comedic beat.
Cuts from the husband's silent reaction shot to the black title/outro card, ending the joke on a hold before the branding beat.

reaction_shots.description: Silent close-up on the husband's unimpressed, deadpan face immediately after the wife's punchline, functioning purely as a reaction beat rather than advancing the dialogue.

pacing_notes: Shot length is uneven and driven by dialogue rather than a steady rhythm: a 3.4s wide establishing shot sets up the question, then an extended 6.5s close-up on the wife lets three lines of back-and-forth dialogue (her lie, his rebuttal, her deflection) play out in one continuous take. The pace then snaps sharply with a very short ~1.2s reaction cut on the husband for the punchline, before settling into a longer ~1.9s static hold on the title card for the outro/CTA.
